```{r}
# In this block,we call the trainModel() to train our model
train_model <- trainModel(
  X = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  num_iteration = 5000,
  hidden_neurons = 15,
  lr = 0.01,  # 试试 0.1 或 0.01
  verbose = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
plot(train_model$cost_hist, type = "l", 
     xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "Cost",
     main = "Training Loss",
     col="red")
```
```{r}
# Making prediction using the test data
pred_prob <- makePrediction(X_test, train_model$updated_params, hidden_neurons = 15)
pred_class <- ifelse(pred_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

# We here build a confusion matrix
accuracy <- mean(pred_class == y_test)
cat("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4), "\n")

table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = y_test)
```
